selection: Use saved model/window/feature choices. Replay all 15 existing strategies unchanged. The filtered legacy candidate (odds 4–1000, expected return >2%) is applied unchanged to every model, as in previous regression backtests. No strategy tuning.
staking: Original-rule flat: $1 for every original Bet action. Positive-edge flat: $1 only when existing tier sizing permits a bet. Tiers: existing fixed $1–$5 amounts, ceil(100*positive Kelly score), capped at level five. The latter two use identical bets.
accounting: Net = gross return minus stakes; ROI = net / total staked. Synthetic double chance splits a single total stake across 1X2 outcomes with equal payout. Daily drawdown measured from cumulative net including initial zero.
capital: Fixed stakes, no compounding, bankroll cap, fees, taxes or minimum-stake rounding. Max daily exposure and drawdown are dollar amounts, not bankroll percentages. Each strategy is a separate counterfactual; never add strategy profits together.
limits: Historical Bet365 prices, not live bets or Winner prices. 2021-22 audit and 2022-23 test have been previously inspected. Best-in-table results are hindsight rankings, not independently selected profitable strategies. Existing EA/odds timestamp limitations remain.
